note: The AudioReach primary HAL, PAL, AGM, the AGM ALSA plugins and audioadsprpcd are built from Fairphone's published FP6 audio sources (branch odm/public-build/target/16/fp6), the same sources as the stock FP6.QREL.16.111.0 build apart from Fairphone's publication changes (closed headers dropped, memory logger and feature statistics compiled out). DiamaneOS forks carry only build changes; each fork's NOTICE reproduces its licences. Module names and install paths match stock.

sources.changes: No VINTF fragment (the device manifest declares IAGM); effect libraries not built here (device audio/effects); unused kernel header dependency dropped; board platform matched without Qualcomm's build macro; CFI and integer overflow sanitizer. getParameters no longer answers the factory speaker queries and setParameters no longer accepts the factory speaker protection modes; voice UI keys are ignored without a sound trigger HAL; log format strings fixed.

unlicensed_files.status: Published by Fairphone, no licence header (Copyright AWINIC Technology CO., LTD). Used as published (owner decision, 2026-10-06). Compiled into libar-pal as in stock; nothing in PAL or the HAL calls it (stock neither). The amplifier calibration is loaded by the kernel aw882xx driver.
Published by Fairphone, no licence header: interface declarations written by community contributors (Git history). Included in libar-pal.
Published by Fairphone, no licence header; not compiled for volcano.

sources.changes: Kernel UAPI from the device header library (misc/adsp_sleepmon.h) instead of the kernel build output; closed header libraries dropped (their features are compiled out by Fairphone's PAL_MEMLOG_UNSUPPORTED and AUDIO_FEATURE_STATS_UNSUPPORTED); Bluetooth codec and voice UI plugins not built; CFI and integer overflow sanitizer; NOTICE added. Compiler fixes for Android 17: log format strings, constructor order, a switch fall-through, an always-true condition kept with its stock behaviour. The FTM query checks that speaker feedback runs.
